email.subject: AI for Fromen Injury Law, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Christina,

Your firm's 60-year track record handling products liability and federal trial practice across Western New York speaks to the caliber of work you do. I also noticed Fromen sponsors the High School Club Hockey League, which reflects the community investment that defines firms like yours.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to regional practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into upstate New York to meet firms doing the kind of complex litigation you handle. I'd be happy to stop by your Buffalo office to show how we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
